gather.zh-Hant: 一張紙落在海上，紙上的字活了。
gather.zh-Hans: 一张纸落在海上，纸上的字活了。
gather.en: A sheet of paper falls on the sea, and the characters on it come alive.

build.en: Gather wood. Lay bricks. Write yourself a home.

night.zh-Hant: 第十三夜起，魄夜行。點一盞燈，撐過這一夜。
night.zh-Hans: 第十三夜起，魄夜行。点一盏灯，撑过这一夜。
night.en: From the 13th night, the spirits walk. Light a lamp and hold out until dawn.

snow.en: Live by the solar terms: snow,

crops.zh-Hant: 種五穀，字一筆一筆長出來。
crops.zh-Hans: 种五谷，字一笔一笔长出来。
crops.en: Sow the five grains and watch them grow, stroke by stroke.

gaze.en: At night, look up and learn the stars.

sail.en: When your courage is enough, build a boat and cross the sea.

gong.en: Find Gonggong, who tilted the world.
